rows.quote: For the primary analysis, we retrieved GWAS summary statistics for sepsis (ICD-10 code: A41) from the FinnGen consortium (Round 9), including 12,301 sepsis cases and 332,343 controls of European descent.[16] As external validation, we obtained independent GWAS data from the UK Biobank (2811 cases and 406,150 controls).[17] All datasets used were publicly available and approved for secondary analysis; therefore, no additional ethical approval was required.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states Round 9 of the consortium data.
Cohort name with case/control counts and a general cohort reference.

rows.quote: To validate findings, we extracted additional pQTL data from the Fenland Study, which includes measurements of 4775 proteins in 10,708 individuals of European ancestry.[15] The same filtering criteria were applied.
